[selected_pilot.GetName]在进入机动动作时保持着明显的领先优势，但这种优势随后开始消退。

出了点差错，可能是失误、操作不当，或者仅仅是由于紧张。总之，对手轻松反超，我们的飞行员最终只落得个平淡无奇的第四名。
texts.en:
The atmosphere aboard Arkship [Root.GetName] was palpable as the finalists hit the last slingshot around [Star.GetName].

[selected_pilot.GetName] held a clear lead entering the manouver, but the edge began to fade.

Something slipped, a missed mark, a loose line, maybe just nerves. Either way their rivals eased past and our pilot crossed the finish in an unremarkable fourth.

texts.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的气氛异常紧张，入围者们正在[Star.GetName]进行最后的弹射。

我们的赛手在进入机动动作时保持着明显的领先优势，但这种优势随后开始消退。

出了点差错，可能是失误、操作不当，或者仅仅是由于紧张。总之，对手轻松反超，我们的飞行员最终只落得个平淡无奇的第四名。
texts.en:
The atmosphere aboard Arkship [Root.GetName] was palpable as the finalists hit the last slingshot around [Star.GetName].

Our racer held a clear lead entering the manouver, but the edge began to fade.

Something slipped, a missed mark, a loose line, maybe just nerves. Either way their rivals eased past and our pilot crossed the finish in an unremarkable fourth.

texts.zh:
围绕方舟舰[Root.GetName]的竞赛以悲剧告终，一场高速碰撞导致碎片散落在整个恒星系中。在对准绕[Star.GetName]的最后一次引力弹射航线时，我们的飞行员与对手靠得太近，导致两艘飞船都失控旋转。

[selected_pilot.GetName]由于救援及时幸存了下来，但伤势严重，将留下永久的伤疤。
texts.en:
The race around Arkship [Root.GetName] ended in tragedy when a high-speed collision scattered debris across the system. While lining up the final slingshot around [Star.GetName], our pilot closed too tightly on a rival and both ships spun out.

[selected_pilot.GetName] survived thanks to rapid rescue, but suffered severe injuries and will carry lasting scars.

texts.zh:
围绕方舟舰[Root.GetName]的竞赛以悲剧告终，一场高速碰撞导致碎片散落在整个恒星系中。在对准绕[Star.GetName]的最后一次引力弹射航线时，我们的飞行员与对手靠得太近，导致两艘飞船都失控旋转。

我们的候选人因救援及时得以幸存，但伤势严重，并将留下永久的伤疤。
texts.en:
The race around Arkship [Root.GetName] ended in tragedy when a high-speed collision scattered debris across the system. While lining up the final slingshot around [Star.GetName], our pilot closed too tightly on a rival and both ships spun out.

Our candidate survived thanks to rapid rescue, but suffered severe injuries and will carry lasting scars.

texts.zh:
方舟舰[Root.GetName]上的气氛异常紧张，入围者们正在[Star.GetName]进行最后的弹射。

由于我们选中的飞行员完美地执行了机动动作，胜利似乎已是囊中之物，直到那艘“黑貂号”闪现而过。一艘此前未标记、也未被注意到的参赛船只从我们的领先者身边掠过，并率先冲过了终点线。

在[Root.GetName]上，面对这残酷的结局，观礼台陷入了一片死寂。
texts.en:
The atmosphere aboard Arkship [Root.GetName] was palpable as the finalists hit the last slingshot around [Star.GetName].

Our selected pilot's victory seemed assured as they executed the maneuver flawlessly, until the Sable Ship flashed by. An unmarked, until-then unnoticed entrant swept past our front-runner and crossed the line first.

Aboard the [Root.GetName], the galleries fell silent at the brutal finish.

label.zh: 我们要黑貂号的飞行员！
label.en: We want the pilot of the Sable Ship!

label.zh: 此人没有登记报名，我们的飞行员还是赢了！
label.en: They were never registered, our pilot still won!
